Dear President Trump,

My name is Andre Miller, and I am a former drug addict and alcoholic who has been sober for 16 years. My journey to recovery was profoundly impacted by the restoration of my testosterone levels, which had been severely affected by my addiction. Optimizing my hormones was monumental in transforming my drive and zest for life—it felt like a rebirth.

Inspired by the changes I experienced, I began sharing my story wherever I went, even promoting the clinic that treated me. However, I soon realized that many clinics prioritized profit over the well-being of their clients. This realization motivated me to start my own business by purchasing a franchise . Unfortunately, after a few years, I discovered that I was being taken advantage of by the parent company. After enduring this for four years, I was finally released from my contract.

During this time, I founded the Frontline Hero Foundation, dedicated to assisting veterans and first responders facing financial crises. My mission has always been to save lives—specifically, to prevent even one person from feeling so hopeless that they consider taking their own life. I understand firsthand how low testosterone can lead to depression and how these issues can affect both men and women.

My wife and I have donated over $100,000 of our own money to provide treatment for these brave men and women who have been turned away by the VA. Despite facing multiple hostile takeover attempts, I continue to thrive as one of America’s most trusted clinics. My passion lies in helping restore marriages and create families while guiding individuals toward a healthier lifestyle.

We are committed to serving those on the frontlines, including many federal agency employees who require this treatment due to the stresses of their work. We would greatly appreciate any help, guidance, or recommendations you could provide to further our mission.

Thank you for your time and for your commitment to Making America Great Again. Together, we can make a difference in the lives of those who serve our country.

Sincerely,

Andre Miller
